newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Triplenic buys 12 Hong Kong properties.
newsitem.headline: Triplenic buys 12 Hong Kong properties.

text.p: Property investment concern Triplenic Holdings Ltd said it has agreed to buy 12 residential flats at South Horizons on Hong Kong island from third party Super Spirit Ltd for HK$54.7 million.
The company said the properties cover a total gross floor area of 9,117 square feet at South Horizons, a residential development on the south side of Hong Kong island.
"The directors believe that the property market in Hong Kong will continue to be robust this year," managing director So Kwok Hoo said in a statement.
The company said it would hold the properties for rental income. It did not state the size of the flats.
The deal is expected to be completed on April 8, with the purchase funded by bank borrowings and internal resources, it said.
